name: Anointing Sacred
overview: Scripture reveals the sacredness of the holy anointing oil, meticulously compounded by the priests using specific spices and olive oil, as prescribed in Exodus 30:23-25. This anointing oil was used to consecrate Aaron and his sons, setting them apart for the priestly office and establishing an everlasting priesthood (Exodus 40:13-15). The anointing signifies God's divine appointment and protection over His chosen servants, underscoring the holiness and exclusivity of this sacred practice.
